name: Jigen
summary: Jigen was a novice monk that had his body taken over by Isshiki Ōtsutsuki and eventually became his vessel, acting as an Inner of Kara and its surrogate leader.

name: Koji Kashin
summary: Koji Kashin is a clone of Jiraiya that was created by Amado Sanzu for the purpose of killing Isshiki Ōtsutsuki. A former Inner of Kara, he was in charge of the sector on the outskirts of the Land of Fire. At some point in the three years following Boruto Uzumaki's forced defection from Konohagakure after his life was altered, Koji became Boruto's aide and newest teacher in his quest to eliminate Code and the God Trees, involving to aid Boruto to prove his innocence and regain everything that was taken from him.

name: Kawaki
summary: Kawaki is a boy who was originally raised by Kara, who experimented on him for years with plans of making him the perfect vessel of Isshiki Ōtsutsuki. He is eventually rescued by Konohagakure and adopted into the family of Naruto Uzumaki. His love for Naruto and his hatred for the Ōtsutsuki Clan ultimately leads to accidentally switching lives with his adoptive brother, Boruto, causing most of the world to think of him as Kawaki Uzumaki.

kara.role: The chosen vessel for the organisation.

jutsu.name: Fire Release: Soaring Flame Bullet Technique

name: Ōga
summary: Ōga is a former Inner and scientist of the organisation, Kara.

name: Isshiki Ōtsutsuki
summary: Isshiki Ōtsutsuki was a member of the Ōtsutsuki clan's main family who originally came to Earth with Kaguya to plant a God Tree and harvest its chakra fruit. He was betrayed by Kaguya, who left him for dead, and took over the body of a novice monk named Jigen, who he also branded with a Kāma. Centuries later, he became the leader of Kara as Jigen in order to continue to carry out his original plan, as well as secure a new, better vessel in Kawaki. He was forced to resurrect in Jigen's body, and died without being able to apply a new Kāma, leading to his soul being extinguished, but not before entrusting his failed vessel and loyal follower Code with carrying on the Ōtsutsuki Will.

kara.status: Expired from improper revival; soul extinguished with no vessel

name: Amado Sanzu
summary: Amado Sanzu is a former Inner from the organisation Kara and was the head of its research and development division. He has since defected to Konohagakure, where he used a mix of bluffs and gifts to gain official citizenship for the Seventh Hokage's protection.
